args.title: Cold-Chain Logistics 2026 — Summary
args.body:
- Temperature excursions in cold-chain logistics fell 30% in 2026 among carriers that shared live sensor data in real time.
- Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads at delivery, rather than from an actual reduction in spoilage rates.
- The companion piece reports that cold-chain pilot programs cut insurance/claims costs by roughly 25%, reinforcing that visibility tech pays off mainly through fewer disputed/rejected shipments.
